title: Pan Bagnat with Tuna, Egg and Olives
summary: A crusty loaf is spread with an olive, caper and anchovy relish, filled with tuna, tomato, hard-cooked egg, rocket and basil, wrapped tightly and pressed for an hour.
equipment: baking tray and a heavy pan or tins to weigh

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
anchovy fillets in oil, patted dry
large baguette or long crusty loaf (about 320 g)
145 g cans tuna in olive oil, drained

steps.title: Cook the eggs
steps.text: Simmer 11 minutes, chill, peel and slice.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.text: Toss the red onion with vinegar, garlic and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Make the relish
steps.text: Pulse the olives, parsley, capers, anchovies and mustard powder and stir in with oil.

steps.title: Prepare the bread
steps.text: Split, hollow slightly and toast briefly.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Layer relish, tuna, tomato, egg, rocket and basil.

steps.title: Press
steps.text: Wrap tightly and weigh down for 1 hour before slicing.

tips: Pressing is what makes it; do not skip it.
Toasting the bread first stops it going soggy.
It travels well, which makes it ideal for picnics.
storage: Keep wrapped in the fridge and eat within 24 hours. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
